profile.headline: Software Engineer at Facebook
profile.summary: I am creative Software Engineer with a strong work ethic and tenacity for solving complex problems with simple code.  I have a strong technical background in Aerospace Engineering and Computer Science.  I apply scientific knowledge and practicality to come up with the best possible real world solutions. I am good at dissembling problems and working in groups to get a diverse set of solutions to a problem.   I am study Artificial Intelligence as a hobby and have worked with various online tools to create robots in different contexts. Possess an Active DOD Secret clearance

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Going through team match not sure where I'll land yet.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead the team writing the policy management tool. 

Technology is c#, Net 4.8, web api, vue.js, entity framework. 

Building a bi-temporal database to give accurate history of records. Implement the temporal db with reusable generic framework so it can be applied to any table. 

Consultant at AIM to FTE.

positions.title: Lead Technical Architect
positions.description: Technology lead, manager, and project managerat TrueForm.io in Woodinville, WA.  Working on React, Typescript, .NET Core website.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: As a Software Developer, I have worked with the US Army Criminal Investigative Division to build web applications for Criminal Data Management.  I designed the security framework for the new ALERTS system in C#, interfacing with SiteMinder (Single Sign On).  I have also aided in the maintenance of the Legacy ASP Classic application.  I have worked with other team members to advocate for unit testing and continuous deployment on our project.

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.description:
Accomplishments:

Designed Lego NXT courses in Bolivia to encourage problem solving through robotics. 

Taught English as a second language in Okinawa Numero 1, Bolivia.

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.description: I was a volunteer in Haiti after the earthquake, helping to assess the structural integrity of buildings and building computer software to track data for the organization.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Found open source code to automate data entry into the Federal Data Registry and created a plug in that validated and verified the new data versus model data.
Demonstrated the functionality of the Digital NOTAM System to participating airports. 
Translated AIXM metadata into a definition based relational database. 
Analyzed the hazards associated with the transition to automation of NOTAMs.
